title: Register Accepted Response DTO
description: HTTP 202 body for POST /api/v1/auth/register, returned for non-invite self-registration when the deployment enables activation confirmation. The body is fixed and identical whether or not the email address is already registered. The response carries Cache-Control: no-store. No user, token or account state is returned; the mailbox owner completes activation through POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email.
